programme.title: Married At First Sight

programme.title: Married At First Sight
programme.desc: Strangers are matched by experts and marry upon first meeting, embarking on a high-stakes social experiment. Through challenges and partner swaps, their compatibility is tested, leading to dramatic outcomes and final decisions.
